# Best Background Verification Companies in India for Startups & SMBs (2026)


September 15, 2026


[Shashank Yadav](https://salarybox.in/blog/author/shashank87cc9f270b/)


[No comments yet](https://salarybox.in/blog/best-background-verification-companies-in-india-for-startups-smbs-2026/#respond)


There is a particular frustration that every startup founder and SMB HR manager knows. You Google “background verification companies in India” and every result is built for enterprise. The platforms want annual contracts. The vendors want volume commitments. The pricing pages say “Contact Sales.” And somewhere in the process, you realise that the entire BGV industry was designed for companies that hire 500 people a year, not 5.


That is changing. In 2026, a new wave of self-serve, pay-per-check verification platforms has made professional-grade background screening accessible to companies of any size. You no longer need to sign a 12-month contract to verify a single candidate’s PAN card. You do not need a procurement team to negotiate per-check rates. And you definitely do not need to sit through a 45-minute product demo before you can run your first verification.


But the market is crowded, and not every platform suits every company. Some are built for speed and simplicity. Others offer depth at the cost of complexity. A few try to do everything and end up doing nothing particularly well.


We evaluated the options that actually work for startups and small-to-mid-sized businesses, companies hiring between 5 and 500 people per year, with lean HR teams and limited tolerance for bureaucracy. Here are the eight that made the cut, ranked by how well they serve this specific audience.


## 1. Compose1 Verify


**Why it is number one for startups and SMBs**


Every other platform on this list requires either a contract, a minimum commitment, or at least a sales conversation before you can run your first check. Compose1 does not.


You go to[compose1 verify](https://compose1.com/verify/) , create an account, and run a verification. That is the entire onboarding process. There is no demo. There is no sales call. There is no contract. You pay for the checks you run, and you see the complete price before you pay.


For a startup founder who needs to verify a senior developer’s identity before the offer goes out tomorrow morning, this is not a nice-to-have feature. It is the reason Compose1 exists.


The platform covers the checks that matter most for everyday hiring: PAN verification, Aadhaar verification, Voter ID, Driving Licence, UAN-based employment history verification, and address confirmation. Everything runs against government databases, not photocopied documents, which means results are definitive rather than opinion-based.


The feature that separates Compose1 from basic identity-check tools is the automatic cross-record confidence analysis. When you verify multiple documents for the same candidate, the platform compares the data points across all of them and flags any inconsistencies. A name mismatch between PAN and Aadhaar. A date-of-birth discrepancy between Voter ID and Driving Licence. A UAN record that shows no employment at a company the candidate claims to have worked at for three years. These are the discrepancies that slip through when you check documents one at a time. Compose1 catches them automatically.


The UAN verification alone makes this platform worth using. Traditional employment verification means calling previous employers and waiting 5 to 10 days for a response, if they respond at all. UAN pulls employment history directly from EPFO government records in minutes. Employer names, dates, contribution amounts. Tamper-proof and instant.


**What it costs:** Pay per check. No subscriptions, no contracts, no minimums.


**How fast:** Identity checks return in minutes. UAN same day.


**Best for:** Any company that hires between 1 and 500 people per year and does not want to deal with vendor management.


## 2. SalaryBox


**Why it works for SMBs who want everything in one place**


Most SMBs do not have separate software for attendance, payroll, leave management, and background verification. They use spreadsheets for half of it and memory for the rest. SalaryBox replaces all of that with a single app.


SalaryBox is, at its core, an HRMS and payroll platform and it is one of the most popular ones in India, with over a million downloads and thousands of active businesses. It handles staff attendance through biometric, GPS, facial recognition, and QR-based check-in. It automates payroll calculation, generates salary slips, manages leave and shift schedules, and stores employee documents. For the average Indian SMB a restaurant chain, a retail store, a construction company, a small IT firm SalaryBox is the entire HR department in a mobile app.


The background verification layer is what makes SalaryBox relevant to this list. Through its integration with Compose1 Verify, SalaryBox lets you trigger identity and background checks directly from the employee onboarding workflow. New hire added to the system? Run a PAN and Aadhaar check before their first day. The verification report sits in the same platform as their attendance record and payslip.


This integration matters more than it sounds. When your verification records, payroll records, and attendance records all live in the same system, compliance audits become trivial. You can demonstrate, from a single dashboard, that you verified the employee’s identity, that they showed up for work, and that you paid them correctly. For companies subject to DPDP Act compliance, labour code audits, or POSH Act scrutiny, this consolidated record is valuable evidence of due diligence.


The mobile-first design is practical for businesses where HR decisions happen on the shop floor, not in a corner office. A store manager in tier-3 India can onboard a new staff member, run an identity check, and set up their payroll all from a phone, in under 10 minutes.


**What it costs:** Free tier for basic HRMS; paid plans for advanced features. BGV checks are pay-per-check via Compose1.


**How fast:** HRMS setup in minutes. BGV checks return in minutes to same day.


**Best for:** SMBs that want attendance, payroll, HRMS, and background verification in a single platform without managing multiple vendors.


## 3. SpringVerify


**Why startups like it**


SpringVerify has built a reputation as the BGV platform that “gets” startups. The interface is clean, the candidate experience is smooth (candidates get a link, submit documents, and tracking is real-time), and the integration with modern ATS platforms like Lever, Greenhouse, and Darwinbox makes it a natural extension of the hiring workflow for Series A through Series C companies.


Their turnaround on education and employment checks is competitive typically 2 to 5 days and they provide proactive status updates rather than forcing you to chase them. For a 100-person startup with a full-time recruiter, SpringVerify fits neatly into the existing process.


The limitation for very early-stage startups is that SpringVerify’s pricing starts to make sense at a certain volume. If you are hiring three people this quarter, the per-check economics may not be as attractive as a pure self-serve model like Compose1.


**Best for:** Funded startups with 50-500 employees and a dedicated recruiter or TA team.


## 4. AuthBridge


**Why it matters even for SMBs**


AuthBridge is the enterprise incumbent, the largest BGV company in India by volume and database depth. It is not built for startups. The sales process involves contracts, account managers, and implementation timelines.


But it appears on this list because some SMBs need checks that self-serve platforms cannot provide: criminal background checks with physical court visits, international credential verification, credit checks, drug testing, or directorship and litigation searches. If your hiring profile includes C-suite executives, BFSI compliance roles, or candidates with international backgrounds, AuthBridge offers a depth of investigation that digital-first platforms do not attempt.


The practical approach for most SMBs is to use Compose1 for day-to-day identity and employment verification and bring in AuthBridge only for senior hires or specialised checks that require physical investigation.


**Best for:** SMBs that occasionally need deep, investigation-grade screening for senior or high-risk hires.


## 5. OnGrid


**Why it works for frontline hiring**


If your business hires delivery drivers, warehouse workers, security guards, or store staff, OnGrid is built for your use case. The platform is designed for speed and volume in the blue-collar and frontline segment, where a candidate needs to start work tomorrow, not next week.


OnGrid’s identity and address verification is fast and affordable. Bulk upload capabilities allow operations teams to verify dozens of candidates simultaneously. The platform is less comprehensive for white-collar checks like education verification at tier-1 universities or detailed reference calls, but for the frontline segment, it covers the essentials effectively.


**Best for:** Logistics companies, delivery platforms, QSR chains, security agencies, and staffing companies.


## 6. IDfy


**Why it is the developer’s choice**


IDfy is not a traditional BGV company. It is an identity intelligence platform that provides verification capabilities through APIs. If your company has an engineering team and you want to embed identity verification into your own product a lending app, a gig platform, a customer onboarding flow, IDfy’s API-first approach is the cleanest way to do it.


For HR teams without engineering support, IDfy might feel more technical than necessary. But for companies that are building products where identity verification is a core feature, IDfy provides face matching, liveness detection, document OCR, and database verification with the kind of developer documentation and API reliability that makes integration straightforward.


**Best for:** Fintech companies, NBFC platforms, gig economy apps, and any company that needs to embed verification into a consumer-facing product.


## 7. HelloVerify


**Why it appeals to cost-conscious SMBs**


HelloVerify offers one of the most affordable per-check rates in the market, which makes it attractive for SMBs that need basic identity and education verification without the premium pricing of enterprise providers. The platform covers standard checks identity, employment, education, criminal, and address and delivers results within 3 to 7 days.


The trade-off is technology. HelloVerify’s platform is functional but not as polished as SpringVerify or Compose1. The reporting is adequate for compliance purposes but lacks the automatic cross-record analysis that catches subtle discrepancies. For price-sensitive companies where the primary need is basic verification rather than sophisticated fraud detection, HelloVerify gets the job done.


**Best for:** Cost-conscious SMBs that need basic, no-frills verification at competitive rates.


## 8. BetterPlace (VerifyBetter)


**Why it works for distributed workforces**


BetterPlace started as a frontline workforce management platform and added verification as a natural extension. Their strength is managing large, distributed workforces across multiple locations, think facility management companies, retail chains with 50 stores, or construction firms with workers spread across multiple sites.


The verification is integrated into their broader workforce management suite, which includes onboarding, compliance tracking, and attendance. For companies that need both workforce management and verification for blue-collar and grey-collar employees, BetterPlace offers a unified solution.


**Best for:** Facility management companies, multi-location retailers, and businesses with large distributed frontline workforces.


---


## The Practical Stack for Most Startups and SMBs


After evaluating all eight platforms, the most practical setup for the average Indian startup or SMB looks like this:


**For everyday hiring (all roles):** Use Compose1 Verify. It handles identity, employment history (UAN), and address verification instantly, with no contracts and no vendor management. This covers 80% of what most companies need.


**For your entire HR operation:** Use SalaryBox. Attendance, payroll, leave, HRMS, and employee document management in one app. BGV is built in through Compose1, so verification records sit alongside payroll and attendance records in a single system.


**For senior or high-risk hires (optional):** Bring in AuthBridge or SpringVerify on a case-by-case basis for deep investigation, criminal court checks, or international verification.


This layered approach gives you comprehensive coverage without the complexity or cost of a single enterprise contract. You pay for what you use, you own the workflow, and you are not locked into a vendor relationship that takes six months to exit.


---


*Disclaimer: Rankings are based on suitability for startups and SMBs specifically, evaluated against publicly available information as of August 2026. Features and pricing change frequently, confirm current details with each provider before purchasing.*
